MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The outlet extenders fit a practical need: keeping power and charging organized around my Echo devices and computer accessories. I would choose one, since both serve the same purpose.",
    "The Blink bundle feels like a plausible next step from my door alarms and Alexa devices, provided its installation and recording requirements suit my home. The headset also fits my computer use, though I would check compatibility and calling needs first."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Buying a webcam for computer calls does not mean I need a standalone camcorder; those serve different purposes for me.",
    "My external hard drive does not establish that I own a spare NVMe drive, and my accessory purchases do not establish a need for these particular charging cables.",
    "The Fire TV Cube fits my interests, but I recently bought a Fire TV Stick 4K Max, so another streaming device offers no clear next step."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa purchases seem to be treated as interest in any connected home device, even though a thermostat requires a separate need and compatible wiring.",
    "My practical electronics purchases seem to be stretched into a broad need for more accessories, without enough evidence that I have the equipment or task they support."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Recent purchases matter because they may already satisfy a need. My Fire TV Stick makes another streamer less useful, and my existing battery tester reduces the appeal of another tester bundled with storage.",
    "My replacement batteries, protection plans, and peripherals suggest that maintaining and extending equipment I already own matters to me. A useful recommendation needs a clear connection to that equipment, rather than just a related product name."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in practical electronics and Alexa devices, but sometimes mistake a related product for a current, compatible need."
}
